instruction.thesis: HYPE breakout continuation thesis (H-521) requires OI in top 15% of 24h range and spot above 24h SMA. OI has declined from the 1.031B peak at entry to 997M (-1.28% on spot), and funding has flipped negative (-5.87% annualized) — the opposite of the positive/neutral funding condition required for breakout continuation. Spot is now below the 24h average. The position is approaching the 2% stop and the thesis conditions are no longer met. Closing to avoid mechanical stop and preserve capital.

instruction.thesis: GOLD FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG short thesis has played out: gold_gc_spot declined from 4,661 to 4,589 (+1.55% gain on short) and gold_hl_funding_ann normalized from 67.52% to 6.83% — an 89.9% decline.
